description: Na₂CeO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing CeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ce atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Ce atoms to form corner-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
